extDescription.message: One search bar instead of two: scope and options in the field, results live in the message list, newest first. With its own fast search index.

optGroupHint.message: Off: flat list, newest message first. On: conversations, sorted by the newest reply.

optLimitHint.message: Applies to the message text search: the newest hits are shown. "Unlimited" can be slow on very large mailboxes (with Gloda at most 20,000). Custom: 100 to 1,000,000. Hits from From, To and Subject are added.

optEnterSnapshot.message: Filter: results in a new tab, narrow down there

optEnterHint.message: Filter: a snapshot of the results in a new tab; the search bar there narrows the results further. Analyze: own analysis page with clickable filters (sender, folder, date, attachment). Ask: a small prompt on every Enter, with "Remember".

optSharedHint.message: Creates three virtual folders, at the top of the “Unified Folders” mode (and under Local Folders): All inboxes, All unread and Follow-up. Put a message into the follow-up by right-clicking it; it gets the tag “Follow-up”. The folders are views on this computer only: nothing is moved on the server. Reading, starring and deleting act on the real messages and therefore also on your other devices.

optSharedMonthsHint.message: The shared inbox only shows messages from the last N months (default 3, 0 = all). This keeps the view fast. “All unread” and “Follow-up” still show everything.

optDbHint.message: Once the own search index is complete, it replaces the Gloda index for full-text search across all folders. Until then NovaBird-Search searches with Gloda. Status and maintenance: "Index" tab.

optDbStateMissing.message: The search index is still starting – using Gloda.

optDbStateIndexing.message: The search index is still being built ($1 mails) – using Gloda until then.

optDbStateEmpty.message: The search index is empty – using Gloda.

optDbStateNotReady.message: The initial build of the search index is not finished yet – using Gloda until then.

optDbStateReady.message: Search index active ($1 mails indexed, version $2).

optDbStateOff.message: The own search index is not used (setting "Never").

optSortRelevance.message: Relevance – EXPERIMENTAL (with bonus for newer mails)

optSortHint.message: Experimental: relevance sorting is not mature yet. Only applies when the own search index is used. Gloda results and the quick header search stay sorted by date.

noteDbOff.message: Search index is OFFLINE – Gloda search

noteDbMissing.message: Search index is starting – Gloda search

noteDbBuilding.message: Search index is being built – Gloda search

noteDbTip.message: The search uses Betterbird's built-in index (Gloda) instead of the own search index: less accurate, no umlaut equivalence, no typo suggestion.

optEnterAnalysis.message: Analyze: open analysis page with filters

askRemember.message: Remember and don't ask again (changeable in settings)

anaGone.message: This analysis is no longer available. Please run the search again.

anaMsgError.message: The message could not be displayed.

noteShort.message: At least 3 characters – Enter searches anyway

noteShortTip.message: Shorter search terms do not trigger a live search (they would match almost the whole index). Press Enter to search anyway.

noteDbTipBroken.message: The search index is unusable. Rebuild it in the NovaBird-Search settings, "Index" tab ("Rebuild index"). Until then NovaBird-Search searches through Gloda (slower, less accurate).

noteDbTipOutdated.message: The search index does not match this version of NovaBird-Search. Please reinstall NovaBird-Search. Until then NovaBird-Search searches through Gloda.

optLimitWarn.message: More than 10,000 hits are not recommended: Betterbird may stop responding for a few seconds or longer while building the list (and the analysis). This applies to any search with a high limit.

optEsrText.message: NovaBird-Search uses experiment APIs. They only run in Betterbird and Thunderbird ESR (Extended Support Release), not in the regular Thunderbird release. We recommend the ESR versions.

selfTestText.message: This version does not fully match $APP$. The following is therefore switched off:

selfTestHint.message: Everything else works normally. A newer version of the add-on usually fixes this.

selfTest_searchBar.message: Search bar in new tabs and windows

selfTest_quickFilter.message: Hiding Betterbird’s quick filter bar (it appears in addition)

selfTest_threadDates.message: Date of the newest message for collapsed conversations

selfTest_sharedFolders.message: Shared folders at the top of the folder pane

uiHint.message: The first run can take quite a while. Betterbird stays usable, but search is limited while indexing (NovaBird-Search uses Gloda meanwhile). You can pause and resume at any time.

rebuildWhyNewer.message: it comes from a newer NovaBird-Search version and cannot be read here

rebuildText.message:
The NovaBird-Search search index cannot be used: $WHY$.

Without the index, NovaBird-Search can only search through Gloda (slower, less accurate). Rebuild the index now? Depending on your mailbox this takes a few minutes; Betterbird stays usable. The old file is kept until the end and only deleted afterwards.

rebuildDeclinedTitle.message: The index will not be rebuilt

rebuildDeclinedText.message: Search speed and result quality are severely limited until the index is rebuilt. The rebuild is required for full functionality and must now be started manually in the NovaBird-Search settings ("Index" tab) ("Rebuild index"). NovaBird-Search will ask again at the next start.

optIndexingHint.message: Paused runs continue later where they stopped.

optLogHint.message: Shows what the search index is doing right now (folders, numbers, reconciliation). Kept across restarts (last 400 lines).

optCompoundLabel.message: How should compound words be found?

optCompQueryText.message: For each search term NovaBird-Search looks in the index word list for longer words that contain it and whose prefix is itself a known word (“Speiseplan” → “Wochenspeiseplan”, but “meldung” does not match “Anmeldung”). No rebuild needed, learns from new mail automatically; the first search for a term can take a moment in very large mailboxes, afterwards it is cached.

optCompIndexText.message: While reading each mail, compound words are already split into their parts (from the word list of your own mailbox, without a dictionary) and stored in an extra index. Searching then needs no word list. When you switch, NovaBird-Search reads all mail again once (about 6–10 minutes for 75,000 mails, twice as long on a fresh install). Downside: a word is only split if both parts also occur often on their own in the mailbox; tests found fewer compounds than the default. Good for comparing.

optCompActiveIndex.message: Active: splitting at indexing time (seed list $1 words).

optConfirmCompound.message: Turn on splitting at indexing time? All mail is read again once for this (may take a few minutes; search uses Gloda meanwhile).

optSwitchedIndex.message: Switched. The index is being read again, see the overlay and log for progress.

optPrivacyText.message: The index contains the text of every mail (up to 100,000 characters) and the attachment names in plain text in the file novabird-db/index.sqlite in the Betterbird profile, like Betterbird's own index. It never leaves your computer. If you back up the profile folders or do not encrypt the disk, you also back up and expose the mail text. Encrypted mails (OpenPGP, S/MIME) are not indexed. “Delete index” removes the file completely.

optVersionText.message: NovaBird-Search uses experiment APIs. They only run in Betterbird and Thunderbird ESR (Extended Support Release), not in the regular Thunderbird release. We recommend the ESR versions; otherwise the add-on does not work, or not permanently.

optMaintHint.message: “Rebuild” puts the old index file aside, reads all mail again and only deletes the old file once the new index is complete. “Delete” removes the file until you rebuild or restart Betterbird. The mails themselves are never changed.

optConfirmReindex.message: Delete the index and read all mail again?

optReindexStarted.message: Rebuild started. You can follow the progress in the overlay.

optLoggingHint.message: Only queries you confirmed with Enter or ended with a hit are saved. Nothing leaves your computer. Later this shows which phrasings the parser should learn.

optLangsHint.message: Search queries are understood as sentences in these languages, e.g. “invoices from Jonas last week”. The default is English plus the language of Betterbird (if supported). Several languages are meant for mixed mailboxes; short words with several meanings (such as “an” in German and in English) may then be misread. The short syntax (from:, to:, von:, an: …) always works.

optDebugHint.message: Also logs every page and slow messages (duration, subject). Turn on only for troubleshooting, it makes the log longer. If indexing stalls, the watchdog reports it even without this option. For problems, first repair the affected folder (right-click → Properties → Repair Folder).

noteSimilarTip.message: Additional hits of the semantic search (beta): messages that match by meaning, even without the search word. Switch off or make stricter: NovaBird-Search settings, "Semantic search" tab.

semIntro.message: Also finds messages by their meaning: "parents meeting" finds the "parent-teacher evening", "pay invoice" the "payment reminder". The hits add to the normal search and are counted as "similar" in the search bar. Everything runs on this computer; only the model is downloaded once from Hugging Face (on request, with checksum).

semModelHint.message: The model is downloaded once and stored in the profile. NovaBird-Search then works through the messages in the background, newest first (without a graphics card about 5 messages per second, much faster with the NovaBird Helper).

semModelMeta.message: Languages $1 · download $2 · memory in the add-on about $3

semRemoveModelConfirm.message: Delete the model from the profile? The computed vectors are kept.

semPhaseWaitingIdle.message: waiting for idle time (no input for a minute)

semPathHint.message: Automatic: if the NovaBird Helper is running and has the model ready, it computes (graphics card, much faster); otherwise, and on errors, the add-on computes on the CPU. An own server (Ollama …) is only used if you select it here.

semIdleOnly.message: Work through older messages only when idle

semIdleOnlyHint.message: Applies only when the add-on computes itself: the first messages are computed right away, the rest only when there was no typing or clicking for a minute. If the helper or another PC computes, older messages are processed right away (this PC then only reads the texts). New searches always run at once.

semKeepHint.message: With the model loaded the add-on needs about 2 GB of memory. While working through messages it stays loaded.

semStrictnessHint.message: How similar a message has to be to show up as "similar".

semHelperHint.message: The NovaBird Helper (nbhelper.exe, Windows) computes on the graphics card via DirectML: about 20 minutes for 70,000 messages instead of several hours. It is installed separately and only starts when NovaBird-Search needs it.

semHelperPreparing.message: The helper downloads the model (once, about 320 MB) …

semHelperNoPermission.message: Without the permission NovaBird-Search cannot start the helper.

semClearConfirm.message: Delete all computed vectors of this model? They will be computed again.

semDataHint.message: The vectors belong to Message-IDs, which are the same on every PC: an export file can be imported on another PC, which then only computes the rest. The file contains no message text, but Message-IDs.

semPhaseWaitingPower.message: On battery: older messages wait (searches continue)

semSyncHint.message: So that not every PC computes everything itself: the helper puts the vectors, encrypted, into a shared folder (NAS, OneDrive, Nextcloud …) and takes over those of the other PCs. No open ports. First PC: enter the folder, leave the code empty, "Pair"; the helper shows a code. Further PCs: enter the same folder and this code.

semSyncNewCode.message: New pairing code: $1 – enter it on the other PCs together with the same folder.

semSyncStateOk.message: Paired with $1 · last sync $2 · sent $3, taken over $4

semPathServer.message: Other PC or server (NovaBird Helper, Ollama, OpenAI-compatible)

semServerHint.message: Ollama or an OpenAI-compatible service (LM Studio, llama.cpp, vLLM …) computes the vectors, on this PC or on another computer in the network. It needs the same model, in Ollama "jina/jina-embeddings-v2-base-de" (F16). Before first use, then hourly and after every error, it computes six probe texts; only if its vectors match those of the add-on do they go into the index. A different model or a heavily compressed (quantized) version is refused.

semServerRemote.message: Note: this address is not on this PC. The subject and text of your messages are sent to this server.

semServerOk.message: Matches: agreement $1, largest deviation $2 ($3 ms). The server computes from now on.

semServerBad.message: Does not match: agreement only $1. The server returns vectors of a different model or quantization and is not used.

semServerNoPermission.message: Without permission for this address NovaBird cannot reach the server.

semServerBadUrl.message: Please enter an address starting with http:// or https://.

semCheckDims.message: Does not match: the model returns vectors of a different length (different model). The server is not used.

semServerNbHint.message: Another PC with the NovaBird Helper computes for this one: start "NovaBird Helper (Netz)" from the Start menu there; clicking its icon in the notification area shows address and pairing code. Requests and answers are encrypted with the code. Here too, six probe texts check before first use and then hourly that the vectors match.

semServerRemoteNb.message: The subject and text of your messages go to this PC, encrypted with the pairing code.

semServerNbNoModel.message: Connected, but the helper on the computing PC does not have the model yet: there, choose "Modell laden …" (load model) in the menu of its icon in the notification area.

semServerNbOtherModel.message: Connected, but the helper on the computing PC has a different model version: bring the helper and NovaBird-Search up to date.

semTimingFmt.message: $1 messages: $2 ms waiting for the texts, result after $3 ms

semServerDisabled.message: Semantic search is still switched off, though: tick the box at the top and the computing starts.
